start.title: La Voix d'En Haut
start.text:
Dieu te parle.
« Fais-toi une arche. Un déluge arrive. »

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Receive God's command to build an ark of cypress wood
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 6:14, 22 — God told Noah to make an ark of cypress wood, and Noah did everything just as God commanded.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Refuse the command and flee the land
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah obeyed God; he did not flee.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Buy an existing ship from a merchant
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah built the ark himself, as God instructed.

mockery.title: Un monde qui observe
mockery.text:
Le monde autour de toi est corrompu et violent.
Ils te regardent construire. Comment réagis-tu ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Keep building the ark by faith
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah built the ark in reverent fear, though warned of things not yet seen.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Abandon the ark to please the crowd
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Scripture says Noah kept building by faith.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Attack the mockers to silence them
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Scripture does not describe Noah attacking anyone.

building.title: Cyprès et Poix
building.text:
Tu rassembles les matériaux que Dieu a commandés.
Comment construis-tu l'arche ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Build it of cypress wood, coated with pitch inside and out
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 6:14 — Make yourself an ark of cypress wood; coat it with pitch inside and out.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Build it from cut stone
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the ark was built of cypress wood, not stone.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Weave it from reeds like a basket
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the ark was made of cypress wood, sealed with pitch.

ark_done.title: Elle est achevée
ark_done.text:
L'arche est complète, exactement comme Dieu l'a commandé.
À quoi ressemble-t-elle ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 6:15-16 — The ark was 300 cubits long, 50 wide, 30 high, with three decks.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] A small round boat with one deck
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis gives specific dimensions; the ark was not a small round boat.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] A raft, flat and open to the sky
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the ark had a roof, three decks, and a door in its side.

animals.title: Les créatures viennent
animals.text:
Les animaux arrivent à l'arche.
Qui prends-tu à bord ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Take pairs of every kind of animal, male and female
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:8-9 — Pairs of clean and unclean animals, birds and creeping things came to Noah, male and female.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Take only sheep and goats
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says every kind of animal came, not only sheep and goats.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Take no animals — only your family
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the animals came into the ark with Noah.

boarding.title: La porte fermée
boarding.text:
Il est temps d'entrer dans l'arche.
Qui entre, et qui ferme la porte ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Enter with your wife, three sons, and their wives; the Lord shuts the door
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:13, 16 — Noah, his wife, his three sons and their wives entered the ark, and the Lord shut him in.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Enter the ark alone, leaving your family behind
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah's whole household entered the ark with him.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Stay outside and close the door from without
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the Lord Himself shut Noah inside the ark.

storm.title: Quarante jours de pluie
storm.text:
Les fenêtres des cieux s'ouvrent.
Que se passe-t-il ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rain falls on the earth for forty days and forty nights
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:12 — Rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] A single storm passes in one day
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the rain fell for forty days and nights.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Only a light drizzle falls
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis describes the fountains of the deep bursting and the windows of heaven opening.

inside.title: Sur les eaux
inside.text:
L'arche flotte sur les profondeurs.
Combien de temps les eaux prévalent-elles sur la terre ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] The waters flood the earth for a hundred and fifty days
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 7:24 — The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] The waters recede in three days
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the waters prevailed 150 days before receding.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] You steer the ark back toward Eden
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis does not describe Noah steering the ark; God kept it afloat.

dove.title: La colombe revient
dove.text:
Les eaux commencent à se retirer.
Comment sais-tu que la terre ferme est proche ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Send out a dove; it returns with a fresh olive leaf
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned to Noah in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Send out a raven that returns with grain
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says the dove — not the raven — brought back an olive leaf.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Open the roof and look with your own eyes only
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah sent out birds to test whether the waters had gone down.

dry_land.title: La terre sous tes pieds
dry_land.text:
Le Seigneur te dit de sortir de l'arche.
Que fais-tu en premier sur la terre ferme ?

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Build an altar to the Lord and offer sacrifices
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis 8:20 — Noah built an altar to the Lord and offered burnt offerings on it.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Begin building a great tower right away
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah's first act was to build an altar, not a tower.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Refuse to leave the ark
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Genesis says Noah came out of the ark when God told him to.

covenant.title: L'arc-en-ciel
covenant.text:
Un arc-en-ciel s'étend dans le ciel.
« Jamais plus je n'inonderai la terre. Ceci est mon alliance avec toi. »
